Job Description:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Service Product Specialist, you will serve as the technical authority for air-insulated switchgear (AIS) and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) service products and solutions within an assigned region. You will support field operations, engineering, sales, and customers by providing advanced technical expertise throughout the equipment lifecycle, including maintenance, troubleshooting, modernization, training, and service development. You will help improve technical excellence, operational readiness, customer satisfaction, and the growth of the AIS and GIS service business. This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of two days per week in the office, with domestic travel of up to 50% to support customer meetings, site visits, field activities, training, and business needs.

Other U.S.-based locations may be considered if they are near a major airport.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Serve as the technical subject matter resource for AIS and GIS service products, systems, and applications.

- Provide advanced technical support to Field Service, Project Management, Operations, Supply Chain Management, and customers.

- Manage technical troubleshooting, root-cause investigations, failure investigations, and corrective actions for complex AIS and GIS service issues.

- Support regional field teams in planning and executing service projects, outages, upgrades, and emergency interventions.

- Support equipment lifecycle activities, including maintenance programs, modernization solutions, obsolescence management, and service offering development.

- Develop technical training materials, application guidance, and knowledge-sharing content for field execution, project management, tendering, and regional service sales.

- Support Sales and Tendering teams through technical expertise, scope validation, risk assessment, and solution recommendations.

- Collaborate across Operations, Supply Chain Management, Quality, Product Service Centers, factories, and engineering organizations to improve service delivery, reliability, safety, and execution efficiency.

- Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

Your Background

- Candidate must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for Hitachi Energy in the United States.

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Eight or more years of experience in high-voltage products, field service, engineering, product support, technical sales support, or technical customer support environments.

- Technical knowledge of AIS, GIS, circuit breakers, or related high-voltage substation equipment, with an understanding of electrical power systems, substations, and utility or industrial customer applications.

- Ability to investigate technical problems, support troubleshooting, recommend practical solutions, and read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, manuals, and test reports.

This pay range is for the position’s base pay only.  This position may be eligible for other compensation including incentive pay and/or allowances.  Candidates will receive additional information during the interview and selection process.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an AI Data & Security Governance Engineer (AIE) at HTA, you will build the technical guardrails that allow our distributed engineering and data science teams to innovate safely.  Instead of just writing policies, the AIE will implement ‘governance as code.’  The AIE will design and deploy automated security controls, manage data access infrastructure, and integrate model evaluation and security checks directly into our CI/CD pipelines.  The AIE will work closely with HTA divisions to ensure that our data storage, LLM deployments, and application architecture remain secure, compliant, and highly performant.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Security, Access & Infrastructure Security

- Automated Access Controls: Design, implement, and maintain granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and identity management across our cloud infrastructure and internal tools

- Data Protection Pipelines: Build automated data masking, anonymization, and encryption mechanisms into data ingestion and processing pipelines

- Infrastructure Security: Secure distributed storage solutions and ensure secure configurations across compute instances and databases

- Cloud IAM hardening, secret management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and zero-trust data access patterns

- Secure vector database architecture (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector) with tenant isolation and metadata-level filtering

AI/MLSecOps & Guardrail Implementation

- Generative AI Security: Engineer and deploy technical safeguards for large language models (e.g., Llama or similar architecture), including input/output filtering to prevent prompt injection and data leakage

- CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated security scanning, fairness/bias testing, and model performance evaluations directly into standard CI/CD deployment manuals

- Model Monitoring: Build telemetry and alerting systems to track model drift, anomalous API usage, and compliance adherence in real-time

Data Governance Infrastructure

- Metadata & Lineage: Develop automated processes to extract and catalog metadata, ensuring end-to-end data lineage is tracked programmatically

- Audit Automation: Build automated reporting scripts and dashboards to provide continuous visibility into data access logs and model compliance for security audits

- Other duties as assigned

EDUCATION, LICENSES, and/or CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

- Master’s degree in Computer Security, AI Engineering/Governance, Software Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience

EXPERIENCE and TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

Technical Experience

- Minimum of five (5) years of software, data, or security engineering experience

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience of programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Bash, Go, or similar languages used in data and infrastructure engineering

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience with AI/ML Ops deploying and securing machine learning models (including generative AI/LLMs) in production environments

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience with DevOps & Automation CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows (e.g., monorepo architecture), and infrastructure-as-code tools

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience in Governance platforms such as Collibra, Immuta, Privacera etc.

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience with frameworks and audits such as NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP LLM Top 10

Domain Expertise

- Minimum of one (1) year of hands-on experience implementing AI guardrails and moderation pipelines (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Guardrails AI)

- Minimum of one (1) year of experience in AI red teaming, adversarial robustness testing, and hallucination/bias monitoring

- Deep understanding of data security principles (encryption, IAM, secure network architecture)

- Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed storage architecture

- Knowledge of AI vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs) and mitigation strategies

Preferred Qualifications

- Minimum of five (5) years of experience working with distributed teams across multiple geographic regions

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and translating them into technical requirement

- 25% travel (international and domestic)

SKILLS and ABILITIES REQUIREMENTS / SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to work in a challenging, small team environment (less than 10 members)

- Ability to prioritize and multitask between multiple responsibilities

As our Senior Quality & Continuous Improvement Manager for the GI Valves Product Group , you will play a pivotal role in strengthening and scaling our global manufacturing operations.

We are seeking a senior manufacturing leader who understands how world-class factories operate and who can drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing performance, planning, process discipline, and operational excellence across a global production footprint.

You will lead the quality and continuous improvement agenda for HVDC valve manufacturing across multiple sites in Sweden, Switzerland, China, India, Saudi Arabia and beyond. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, supply chain and project teams, you will help build scalable, lean and high-performing production systems capable of delivering safe, reliable and high-quality products to our customers around the world.

If you are passionate about transforming manufacturing operations, creating a culture of continuous improvement, and driving measurable business impact through lean principles and quality excellence, we would love to hear from you.

For this role, a Sweden base (in either Vasteras or Ludvika) is required. Occasional global business travel will be required to fulfil this position.

How You'll Make an Impact

- Lead the Global Quality and Continuous Improvement strategy for the GI Valves Product Group, supporting multiple manufacturing sites worldwide.

- Drive lean manufacturing excellence by implementing and maturing continuous improvement methodologies including Lean, PDCA, Six Sigma and structured problem-solving.

- Partner with factory leadership teams to improve productivity, reduce waste, enhance process capability and support manufacturing scale-up.

- Strengthen product quality and reliability through robust production systems, process controls and preventive quality management practices.

- Lead the deployment and maturation of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) across the product lifecycle.

- Ensure lessons learned from design, manufacturing, suppliers and field performance are translated into sustainable operational improvements.

- Govern production quality assurance systems, quality plans, process validation activities, risk-based controls and corrective action programs.

- Use operational and quality performance data to identify systemic issues, prioritize improvement initiatives and ensure sustainable results.

- Build capability across global teams through coaching, training, standardization and the sharing of best practices.

- Foster a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement across manufacturing and cross-functional teams.

Your Background

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

- Extensive experience leading manufacturing, quality, operational excellence or continuous improvement functions within complex industrial environments across a global footprint.

- Proven track record of delivering measurable improvements in manufacturing performance, product quality, reliability and operational efficiency.

- Strong experience working in multi-site, global manufacturing organizations.

- Deep understanding of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.

- Experience implementing and leading APQP, process control systems and advanced quality planning frameworks.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive change across matrix organizations.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment across diverse international teams.

- Willingness to travel globally when required.

Preferred Experience
We are particularly interested in candidates who have developed their careers within high-reliability manufacturing environments , including:

- Automotive

- Aerospace and Defense

- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

- Industrial Automation

- Power Generation and Energy

- Advanced Manufacturing or Heavy Industry

Experience with the following would be highly advantageous:

- World Class Manufacturing (WCM)

- Total Quality Management (TQM)

- Design for Six Sigma (DFSS)

- Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

- Supplier Quality Management

- ISO-based quality systems and industry standards

- ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Expert or equivalent certifications

More About Us
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We value innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we believe diverse perspectives help us achieve better outcomes for our customers and society.
We offer exciting career opportunities, global exposure, and the chance to make a real impact in one of the fastest-growing areas of the energy industry.
Bring your passion for manufacturing excellence, operational leadership and continuous improvement, and help us shape the future of HVDC technology

title: Federal Data Engineer
description:
Job description

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Federal Data Engineer serves as the technical lead responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, and optimizing enterprise data engineering solutions for Hitachi Federal customers.
This highly customer-facing role partners with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Sales Engineers, and customer technical teams to deliver complex professional services engagements leveraging Hitachi's Data Intelligence portfolio.
The successful candidate combines strong software engineering and enterprise data engineering expertise with consulting skills to architect scalable solutions, mentor junior engineers, develop new service offerings, and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

Job Location: DC On Client Site

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Technical Leadership

- Lead the technical delivery of complex professional services engagements from design through implementation.

- Design enterprise-scale data engineering solutions that meet customer business and technical requirements.

- Lead customer architecture workshops, technical planning sessions, and solution reviews.

- Translate customer business objectives into scalable technical solutions.

- Serve as the primary technical escalation point throughout project delivery.

- Drive customer success through high-quality solution implementation and technical leadership.

Professional Services Delivery

- Deliver enterprise data engineering, data integration, and object storage solutions.

- Partner closely with Project Managers to ensure projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned to customer expectations.

- Review Statements of Work (SOWs), technical design documents, delivery checklists, and implementation plans.

- Develop customer-facing architecture documentation, implementation guides, and technical deliverables.

- Communicate project status and technical risks to customers and internal stakeholders.

- Consistently exceed customer expectations for quality, professionalism, and technical excellence.

Solution Design & Development

- Design and develop Java-based applications, APIs, integrations, and automation solutions.

- Develop reusable software components, plugins, and integration frameworks.

- Design scalable enterprise data pipelines and data orchestration workflows.

- Implement RESTful API integrations between enterprise systems.

- Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.

- Troubleshoot complex enterprise software and infrastructure issues.

Innovation & Service Development

- Learn and deliver new Hitachi Federal service offerings.

- Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives and technology evaluations.

- Develop repeatable implementation methodologies and best practices.

- Contribute to internal lab development and service innovation.

- Recommend improvements that increase delivery quality and operational efficiency.

Collaboration & Leadership

- Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across the Professional Services organization.

- Collaborate with Sales Engineers during customer pursuits and technical presentations.

- Partner with Product, Support, and Engineering teams to resolve complex customer issues.

- Support knowledge sharing through documentation, training sessions, and peer mentoring.

- Foster strong customer relationships built on trust and technical credibility.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) Security Clearance required

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience)

- Minimum 8 years of enterprise software engineering, data engineering, or professional services consulting experience

- Proven experience leading technical implementation projects within enterprise environments

- Experience designing enterprise-scale data architectures and integrations

- Strong customer-facing consulting and communication skills

- Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

Required Technical Skills
Candidates should demonstrate expertise in several of the following technologies:
Programming

- Java

- Multi-threaded programming

- REST APIs

- JAX-WS

- XML

- JSON

- SQL

- Bash scripting

Data Engineering

- Enterprise object storage technologies (S3, Hitachi Content Platform, Centera)

- Data migration methodologies

- Enterprise data integration

- Data orchestration

- API-based integrations

Enterprise Platforms

- Linux

- Git

- Maven

- Elasticsearch

- PostgreSQL

- Apache Spark

- Solr

Software Engineering

- Software development lifecycle (SDLC)

- Object-oriented design

- Design patterns

- CI/CD best practices

- Configuration management

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:

- Hitachi Content Platform (HCP)

- Hitachi Content Intelligence (HCI)

- AI and machine learning data pipelines

- Docker

- Kubernetes

- Python

- Apache Kafka

- Apache Airflow

- Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)

- Terraform

- Microsoft Graph APIs

- SharePoint integrations

- Exchange integrations

- Microsoft Work Folder Server APIs

- Security+ Certification (or ability to obtain)

Success Profile
The ideal candidate is:

- A trusted technical advisor who builds credibility with customers.

- Comfortable leading enterprise implementations from architecture through deployment.

- Passionate about mentoring others and developing technical talent.

- Able to communicate equally well with executives, project managers, and engineers.

- Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn emerging technologies.

- Driven to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Why Join Hitachi Federal?
At Hitachi Federal, you'll work alongside some of the industry's brightest technical professionals delivering innovative solutions that directly support federal missions. We invest in our employees through continuous learning, leadership development, and meaningful career growth opportunities while fostering a collaborative culture recognized as a Top Workplace .
If you're passionate about solving complex technical challenges and helping customers unlock the value of their data, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation
Expected Hiring Range: $160,000-$205,000 annually
Hitachi Federal is committed to providing equitable, competitive, and market-based compensation. The expected hiring range listed above represents the anticipated salary range for a qualified candidate at the time of posting and has been established in good faith based on the requirements of the position.
Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including, but not limited to:

- Relevant knowledge, skills, and experience

- Technical expertise and specialized qualifications

- Education, certifications, and professional credentials

- Scope and complexity of prior experience

- Internal equity

- Market data and geographic considerations (where applicable)

- Business needs and budget considerations

This position may also be eligible to participate in Hitachi Federal's annual incentive (bonus) program, where applicable, in accordance with company policies and plan provisions.

Hitachi Federal offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families. Benefits may include:

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

- Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

- 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with Company Match

- Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance

- Flexible Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

- Professional Development and Training Opportunities
